notes: Knightly heraldry for the paladin city: kite shields and shield-and-sword pairs on the wall, pennants and banner rows, a stone spear-bearer and a helm on its pedestal. Core pieces are the silver shields, pennant and helm; the rares are gold, tall and wide.
